canonical_orbit_rule: lexicographically smallest pair among the six signed omega-unit transforms of a nonzero balanced digit pair
digit_policy: recode each of the exact minimum-L1 Eisenstein lattice coordinates in balanced radix 16, with digit range [-8,7]
input_basis: k=x+y*omega modulo r, where x=a+b and y=-b for the existing tau-coordinate reducer
online_policy: one prepared affine orbit point per nonzero joint window, transformed by its unit code and added to a Jacobian accumulator; checked generic fallback on capacity overflow
preparation_policy: prepare [16^i*(u+v*omega)]P for each canonical nonzero orbit representative (u,v); batch-normalize the table with one inversion
training_basis: endo-radix8-inputs/inputs.json; eight cases and 32768 public scalars
training_observation: mean nonzero joint windows were 3.353 on glv-j0-32 and 6.974 on j0-56, with observed maximum positions 4 and 7; no CPU speedup inferred
